title: Special tour
text: Wonderful experience. David was a fantastic tour guide. Very knowledgeable and passionate about this beautiful church. The lighting inside the church during twilight was spectacular. A highlight of our trip.
author: MarkM732

title: Good Experience; Breath-Taking Location
text: Obviously, the architecture of La Sagrada Família itself is the greatest highlight of any trip or tour, but our knowledgeable guide was able to add extra context about the biblical inspirations of various details around the building and the influence of various sculptors and architects who aren’t highlighted in the extensive museum. He used a mixture of religious knowledge, cultural context, and supplemental photographs to make make the information compelling and comprehensive. title: Other-worldly!
text: Other-worldly!  We had a glorious visit to one of the most fascinating and inspiring places I have ever seen.  Our tour was full of passion and knowledge.  5 stars!
author: toddpate67

title: Great tour in this unique church
text:
Great!
The guide (Francesc Palacin) was very close by, but contacted us via WhatsApp beforehand to say he would be there shortly.
A highly dedicated young man with a great deal of knowledge about the details of the Sagrada.
Certainly better than booking directly at the Sagrada; it is cheaper, but we saw that the groups are 2 - 3x as large.
Thanks to Francesc for this great experience
author: Loeblichfamily

title: Gaudi
text: Francesc was the terrific, knowledgable and personable guide during our Familia Sagrado tour. He would definitely use him as a guide again. spoke English well and was understandable. Very passionate about his tour.
author: I9488GVjorgea

title: Awesome Sagrada Familia Tour
text: This was an amazing tour. Our tour guide Francisco (I'm sorry I cant spell his actual name but he said we can call him this!) was friendly, knowledgeable and accommodating throughout. We were really able to get an in depth look at the Basilica with historical, artistic and architectural perspecitive. With a small group size it was easy to ask any questions we would have wanted to. This was an incredible tour. I would recommend it to anyone who wants to visit the Sagrada Familia.
